simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to דָּאַב (H1669) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: דָּאַב (dâʼab) means to pine First listed occurrence: Jer 31 12.

definitions.full: H1669. daeb [ דָּאֵב ] verb become faint, languish (Late Hebrew id. Hiph`il; compare Arabic toil, weary oneself ; see also דְּאָבוֺן דְּאָבָה, & compare דוב ) — Qal Perfect 3feminine singular דָּֽאֲבָה Psa 88:10 (subject עַיִן ); Infinitive לְדַאֲבָה Jer 31:12 לְד יוֺסִיפוּ ׳לֹא (subject ransomed Israel); — 31:25 has דָּֽאֲבָה נֶפֶשׁ , of hunger (|| עֲיֵפָ֑ה נֶפֶשׁ ), where adjective or participle seems needed; Hi Gf דְּאֵבָה or דֹּאֲבָה (the punctuators had, according to them, the Aramaic participle in mind); Thes. makes relative clause.
